temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with Keith over the past few days. When he asks if he upset her, she says no, explains she is dealing with personal stuff, and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: her curtness is not due to anger at him; it is due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him, but she is dealing with personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer support if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers a talk or coffee break. Elizabeth accepts, says it sounds good, and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, not anger at him, and might appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Strengthened: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and appreciates the offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth welcomes his support and is willing to spend a coffee break with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To listen and offer support during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests professional help, and Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under significant personal stress and is open to Keith's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Expanded: her stress seems severe enough that professional help might benefit her, but she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could be useful for Elizabeth, but she is unsure and hesitant; he should be careful not to pressure her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and slightly worried about offending her
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her and encourage professional help gently without overstepping.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the professional-help suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn. After Keith apologizes, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is hesitant about professional help; Keith is concerned he may have overstepped, but he does not yet know how she has taken it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: First he interprets her withdrawal as possible embarrassment or overstepping; then her reassurance changes it to she was not offended and simply has a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not offended or embarrassed by his suggestion; she values his concern but has a lot to process.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and concerned, then reassured/relieved, still sympathetic
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support, avoid pushing her, and remain available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative. She says Keith's support means a lot and that she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but has a lot to think about; Keith wants to maintain a supportive relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/strengthened: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing he is there; maintaining this supportive relationship is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and continue being available for her.
